summary: Verified the news-caching/instant-display feature for MomentumX. Logged in as daniel.r.millner@gmail.com, started the scanner, waited for scan cycles to complete (28 candidate rows returned). Backend curl-verified POST /api/scanner/scan: 28 rows, 0 with null news_articles, 12 with empty array, 16 with non-empty article lists - confirms pre-fetch completes synchronously before response returns. Frontend Playwright testing: clicked 5 different scanner rows (ADVB, LABT, INM, OTLY, re-clicked ADVB) one after another - the News Feed Panel updated INSTANTLY every time (no visible 'Loading...' data-testid='news-feed-loading' state detected even immediately after click or 300ms later), showing real article rows with flame icons and correct sentiment badges (CATALYST, MOMENTUM). Network monitoring confirmed ZERO XHR calls to /api/news/{symbol} were triggered by any of the clicks (all symbols were present in current scan results, so it used the instant scannerResults.news_articles path as designed). Auto-merged mode (no symbol selected) correctly showed 'News - N stocks @ 3/5+' header built from cached data with no fetch delay. Scanner table's single flame badge per row (top-50 criteria verification) rendered correctly and unaffected (ADVB, OTLY both show flame icons). No console errors observed, including when rendering an article with no sentiment badge (neutral, e.g. 'Morning Market Movers' headline rendered cleanly with no badge/crash).
action_items: No action items - feature working as intended. All regression checks passed (flame badges unaffected, no console errors, no fetch-on-click delay).
critical_code_review_comments: NewsFeedPanel.js: clean implementation - useEffect correctly checks Array.isArray(row.news_articles) before using cached data, with sensible fallback axios.get only for symbols not in scannerResults (e.g. new open positions outside scan criteria). No issues found.

scanner_service.py: _attach_full_news_articles only processes rows where news_articles is still None (line 869 'if result.get("news_articles") is not None: skip'), avoiding duplicate work for rows already populated by check_single_news - efficient design, confirmed via backend curl that zero rows ever end up null.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 row clicks instant with zero loading state and zero /api/news/ XHR calls)

context_for_next_testing_agent: This session's feature (instant news display from pre-fetched scanner data) is fully verified working - both backend pre-fetch (curl) and frontend instant-render + zero-fetch-on-click (Playwright network monitoring) confirmed. No open issues from this session. The unrelated chart-stuck-loading bug investigated in iteration_38 remains unreproduced/not relevant here.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this session, feature verification passed cleanly.
